reviewNotes: Historical (2024). ALDI launch batch, reviewed 2026-11-16 against the archived notice (dateline May 9, 2024; ALDI's index says May 7). No Lotly agency case. FDA Enforcement Report has the same recall as F-1289-2024 through F-1295-2024, firm Schreiber Foods Inc, Class II, Terminated: verify how a terminated recall is shown before production. Sell By dates have no field and stay out of the card (never relabeled Best By).

fields.whatHappened: In cooperation with Schreiber Foods, Inc., ALDI recalled its Happy Farms Whipped Cream Cheese Spread, Chive & Onion Cream Cheese Spread, Cream Cheese Spread, and Strawberry Cream Cheese Spread products.
fields.whyRecalled: The products were recalled due to potential salmonella.
instructions: Throw the product away or return it to your local ALDI store for a full refund.
fields.contact: Call Schreiber Foods, Inc. at 1-800-644-5473 or email consumer.relations@schreiberfoods.com.
